01What happens next

Three steps

  1. You send your details. Name, email and, if you like, the team you will work with.
  2. We reply to confirm. You get your confirmation and the next steps by email.
  3. You prepare in an hour or less. The student guide has a setup checklist and optional reading, and nothing in it is required.

This workshop is independent. It is built on the free arc42 template, which was created by Gernot Starke and Peter Hruschka, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by arc42. It does not lead to a certification.
